relationships.subject: circRNA-UBE2G1
relationships.evidence_quote: circRNA-UBE2G1 sponges miR-373 to upregulate HIF-1a, increasing pro-inflammatory cytokine production (IL-1β, IL-6, TNF-α) and chondrocyte apoptosis under lipopolysaccharide stimulation

relationships.subject: PRP secretome
relationships.evidence_quote: Both PRP and MSC secretomes downregulate TNF-α, IL-1β, and MMP-13, curbing the inflammatory-catabolic loop seen in OA

key_findings: Narrative review of PRP, BMAC, MSC, exosome and gene/ncRNA therapies for knee osteoarthritis; ncRNA therapeutics remain preclinical.
Epigenetic regulators including EZH2 influence OA via histone methylation.
